sections.A: Carpal tunnel kalai ke aage haddiyon aur ligament se bani tang jagah hai jis mein se median nerve guzarti hai. Is par dabao se ungliyon mein symptoms hote hain.
sections.B: Angootha, shahadat, beech wali aur aadhi ring finger mein jhunjhunahat, khaas kar raat ko, aur haath jhatakne se aaraam.
sections.C: Kaun si ungliyan, raat ke symptoms, haath jhatakne se aaraam, aur kya gardan mein bhi dard hai.
sections.D: Angoothe ki muscle ka sukhna, ungliyon ki sensation aur angoothe ki taaqat check karein.
sections.E: Carpal compression (Durkan), Phalen aur Tinel tests. Inhein history ke saath parhein.
sections.F: C6 ya C7 radiculopathy (gardan ke signs) aur pronator syndrome isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Kalai ki chot ya fracture ke baad achanak shadeed symptoms, ya lagataar sunn-pan aur angoothe ki muscle ka sukhna: urgent refer.
sections.H: Red flags na hon, median nerve ke symptoms, raat ko barhna, positive tests aur gardan normal: working diagnosis CTS.
sections.I: Kalai ki haddiyon ki mobilisation, median nerve sliders, aur gardan aur thoracic mobilisation.
sections.J: Raat ko kalai seedhi rakhne wala splint, tendon gliding exercises aur kaam mein tabdeeli.
sections.L: Boston questionnaire, raat ko jagna, sensation aur angoothe ki taaqat track karein. Shadeed ho to surgery ke liye refer.
sections.N: 45 saal ki diabetic khatoon raat ko teen dafa sunn ungliyon ke saath jaagti hai. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
